title: A slow browser install never cancels the gates job
why: A slow download mirror must not turn a good batch red.
note: Finding, Oct 26 (build advisor 2, from d6's shared screenshot command): the gates job on batch PR #603 was cancelled at its 36-minute cap inside the "shoot fixture suite" step. Its playwright install --with-deps chromium took over 11 minutes on slow apt mirrors, against 27 s on #595's run. The step has no timeout of its own and shares the job's cap. Re-run once by the build advisor. Fix, one small cloud lane: give the step its own timeout-minutes, or move the shoot suite to its own job, and consider caching the browser; needs no answer from you. Placed ahead of c44 (triage, Oct 26): it can cancel any batch run, like c61 and c62, so it follows them.
